views.rationale: Revenue rose to $261 million in 2020, up $17 million from 2019, and operating margin improved to 24%.
Healthcare loans represent 7% of total corporate loan exposure
U.S. sales increased 2.5% to $43.1 billion in 2020
Net income rose 43% to $17.1 billion and equity underwriting fees jumped 66%
Cost of sales fell to 56.5% of sales, down from 59.0% in 2019
Net income rose $316 million in 2020 and the average retail rate base grew by approximately $3.9 billion, indicating earnings momentum.
Adjusted diluted EPS increased 16% year‑over‑year to $2.22 and total revenues reached $41.9 billion, showing strong top‑line growth.
Net sales grew 8% to $19.7 billion and gross margin improved to 53.1% from 51.4%, reflecting higher profitability.
